notes.title: Exciting News: Release Date & Extra Endings!
notes.notes:
We know you’ve been waiting for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351330/BrokenLore_DONT_WATCH/]BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH[/url], and we wanted to share why the release date got pushed back. Good news, it's for a great reason! We’re using this extra time to add TWO brand-new endings to the game, making your experience even more intense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215569/19f94efd145a15348b870da337e2bc43ab123dcc.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351330/BrokenLore_DONT_WATCH/

But that’s not all… We’ve just dropped a Retro Trailer for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351330/BrokenLore_DONT_WATCH/]BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH[/url]! Go check it out and get a taste of what’s coming.

[previewyoutube=-5GsE9WWXeQ;full][/previewyoutube]

And if you haven’t already, make sure to WISHLIST all our other entries in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][b]BrokenLore[/b][/url] franchise.

notes.title: RELEASE DATE ANNOUCEMENT
notes.notes:
We're super excited to share that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351330/BrokenLore_DONT_WATCH/][b][i]BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH[/i][/b][/url], the next chapter in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][i][b]BrokenLore[/b][/i][/url] series, is coming to Steam on [b]March 20th, 2025[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215569/68e0454c875a4fbef737b42e49a3e544f601912d.png[/img]

This time, we're diving into the tough subject of social anxiety, with Shinji as our main character. He’s a young hikikomori, living in isolation in his Tokyo apartment, struggling with the outside world.

[previewyoutube=BdNmf29ECOw;full][/previewyoutube]

If you haven’t already, be sure to check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014520/BrokenLore_LOW/][i][b]BrokenLore: LOW[/b][/i][/url], the first chapter of the series, which we released recently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215569/ac5e68c8f2eeb4826d87569dbfb9376524a9b6a5.png[/img]

Follow the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][i][b]BrokenLore[/b][/i][/url] series for all the latest updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014520/BrokenLore_LOW/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2846530/BrokenLore_FOLLOW/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2133830/BrokenLore_UNFOLLOW/

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Update - March 5, 2025

Dear players,

We would like to inform you that, due to some exciting news we will be announcing very soon, the release date of our video game has been postponed to April 25, 2025. We are excited to share these new developments with you, which we believe will bring great benefits to the entire series.

Thank you for your continued support and patience.
More details will be shared soon!
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
